identity.name: GitFable Design System
identity.core_philosophy: Coding is writing history. Every PR is a page in your legend.

theme_strategy.vibe: The 'Nether' Archive - A high-tech, magical library of code.
theme_strategy.background_style: Rich Void (#020203) with subtle ambient glows, not flat black.

headings.usage: All major section titles (H1-H3). Creates the 'Fable' narrative feel.

body.usage: UI elements, data tables, card content, navigation.

mono.usage: Code snippets, commit hashes, XP values.

cards.style: Glassmorphism or Flat Dark with 1px border. No heavy drop shadows.

buttons.secondary: Outline or Ghost with subtle hover bg.

inputs.style: Flat background (#27272A), 1px border. Focus: Ring Gold.
inputs.height: h-10 or h-12 for touch targets

required_animations.name: Card Draw Shuffle
required_animations.description: A deck of cards shuffling animation when user clicks 'Draw Issue'. Cards fly out and restack.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5 or 2. No fills unless active state.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. SETUP TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors provided in 'colors.palette'.
3. CARD DRAW LOGIC: The 'Draw' mechanic is the core unique feature. It MUST feel tactile. Use Framer Motion's `drag` or `layoutId` features.
4. NO EMOJIS: Use lucide-react icons exclusively. If a badge needs an image, use the provided Unsplash URLs or a generic SVG shape.
5. DARK MODE: The app should be forced to dark mode initially as per user preference (or default to dark).
6. SHADCN: Heavily customize the default shadcn components. Remove the default white backgrounds and replace with the 'Rich Void' palette.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every interactive element.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
